title: Remove Cad Fixtures Except Concrete Forest
description: Remove all fixtures from cad but concrete forest.
summary: Removed all CAD play fixtures except concrete forest (left and right). Deleted geometry.json, geometry-loom.json, geometry-routes.json, small-building.model.json, tall-building.model.json, large-building.model.json, and simple.spatial.json from cad/asset/play. Updated CAD play shape asset catalog and fixture slugs to only expose concrete-forest-left and concrete-forest-right. Migrated interaction e2e test geometry (loom, routes, building boolean) to inline test constants in cad/js/core/index.ts so tests no longer depend on asset/play fixture files. Updated renderer tests to use concrete forest fixtures instead of small-building.
